videos.title: Dotzauer 6 Pieces for 3 Cellos, Op.104 (No. 1) - Sarah Joy
videos.description:
It's been a while since I released any classical material on my Youtube channel, and I thought this piece would be perfect! I did, however, underestimate the difficulty of accompanying oneself with this sort of piece. Most of the time, entrances and phrasing are directed by the first cello with visual cues and breathing cues. By doing quite a few takes, I finally managed to get one cohesive product. It is completely live with no post-editing! 

To watch my music lessons with bonus material on Curious.com:
https://curious.com/sarahjoytutorials...

To have a Skype lesson with me, email: sarahjoyrecordings@gmail.com

videos.title: Aleksandr. Kuznetsov, Suite Nr. 1 op. 13 - II. Andantino
videos.description:
Aleksandr Vasilyevich Kuznetsov (b. 1847; d. after 1910)
-II. Andantino, from the Suite Nr. 1 op. 13 for cello quartet.

A contemporary of Tchaikovsky's at the Saint Petersburg Conservatory during the 1860s, Kuznetsov became a member of the "Russian Quartet" in Saint Petersburg, and regularly participated in quartet concerts of the Russian Musical Society, in which he regularly played Tchaikovsky's works.

(http://en.tchaikovsky-research.net/pages/Aleksandr_Kuznetsov)

Violoncello I, II, III, IV: Daniel Vargas
2018. Home recording.

videos.title: Scotson Clark.   Gavotte for Violin Quartet
videos.description:
My edition of Gavotte for Four Violins.  Based on ISMLP#82715

Scores and Parts for the full work can be downloaded free at:
https://musescore.com/user/402141/sets/6371677

My aim is to find and transcribe or arrange mostly unknown public domain music suitable for small amateur music groups, usually featuring flutes, recorders and strings. 

If you like this score, please hit 'like' and 'subscribe' to encourage me to find and arrange some more similar music!
